text:
DMSO is also my first remedy for many injuries and some chest pain. After I overused erythritol, I developed angina that lasted for days. I took DMSO, the pain disappeared within about a minute, and it never returned.

Chest pain can come from a clot starting to block an artery, so it's a good sign that DMSO slows clotting. It did in mice, and in human platelets (the blood cells that start clots) in a dish, though that's only animal and lab-dish research so far.
